decisions.statement: A cache sits beside the page of the check that keeps it.
A row is one JSON value on a line of its own.
A cache that is not there reads as nothing rather than as no row.
A cache holding a line that is no JSON value reads as nothing.
A cache is put in place whole, so a reader reads it as it was or as it is.
A cache already holding what would be written is left alone.
Nothing here says what a check keeps or when a check keeps it.

definition: what a check keeps beside its own page from one run to the next
